div.style: font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; border-left: 2px solid #79C0FF; padding: 4px 0 4px 14px;
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: Smart city parking you book before you arrive — find a lot on a live OpenStreetMap map, soft-lock a slot sized to your vehicle for as long as the drive takes, and walk in with a signed QR that needs no signal.
